rdfs:label: invalidated
rdfs:comment: An Entity that this PROV Activity destroyed, consumed, or rendered unusable — after invalidation the Entity is no longer available for further use.
notes: Models destruction or consumption explicitly: a delete operation invalidates a record, a publish step invalidates a draft. Distinct from `prov:used` (began using it as an input, possibly consuming it) and `prov:generated` (created). Useful in audit trails and data lifecycle tracking. Activity → Entity; `urn:solid:wasInvalidatedBy` is the Entity → Activity direction.

history.note: Domain and example type now prov:Activity; corrected prov:used wording; added notToBeConfusedWith wasInvalidatedBy.
